title: Zestful Zucchini Starch
description: A citrusy and tender low-carb-friendly Tunisian dish featuring potato starch, blanched vegetables for a show-off touch in this easy to prepare meal.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup potato starch
ingredients.notes: slightly dampened with water to bind

instructions: Slice the zucchinis into coins about 1/4 inch thick.
Sprinkle a little salt and pepper on both sides of the sliced zucchini.
In a small bowl, mix the potato starch with water until smooth. Add lemon juice if using for extra brightness.
Dip each slice of zucchini in the starch mixture and arrange them evenly in a baking dish or oven-safe skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until crisp and golden brown on top.
Serve hot with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and additional minced garlic if desired.
